notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.16 bundles Browser CRM V3.1 and adds the first real Supabase Cloud CRM connection step. Settings now accepts the Supabase Project URL and browser-safe publishable key locally, rejects secret/service-role keys, and provides GitHub OAuth sign-in from FirstSeen. Browser CRM prefers http://localhost:3210/ so Supabase can use a stable local redirect URL, with an available-port fallback if needed. A read-only Test cloud leads action authenticates as the signed-in user and reads the Supabase leads table through Row Level Security, showing the visible cloud lead count and recent lead names. This version deliberately does not upload, overwrite, merge or delete existing Desktop SQLite leads; full sync remains disabled until the read-only connection is verified. Existing lead messaging, cold-call scripts, Twilio calling, outcomes, follow-ups, Finder shortlist, business summaries, SQLite CRM data and updater behaviour are preserved.
